title: IFA_EVENT envelope v2
description: Universal envelope for every event an IFA module emits. Version 2 names the instance's premises once and lists the sources the event came from, each with its area; version 1's factory-shaped location is gone. The payload is typed per event_type; its schema lives in the event_types registry, referenced by (event_type, event_type_version).

event_type.description: Bare snake_case for module events; the dotted form reserves namespaces (platform.*) for non-module events.

premises.description: The premises the module instance is on. Every source the event lists is on it too.

sources.description: The sources the event came from: each one bound to the emitting instance.

area.description: Where the source sits within its premises, in the tenant's own words. Free text; the platform never reads meaning from it.
